# A 100.00 invoice paid 250.00 — the customer overpaid by 150.00.
#
# The payment settles the invoice with 100.00 and leaves 150.00 as the
# customer's credit, which is what `prepayment:` states. Printed and read into
# a book that does not already hold the deposit, the block has to say both
# figures or the 150.00 is not entered at all.
#
# Accounts come from payment_roundtrip_accounts.txt, so the same printed
# page can be read into a fresh book built from that file alone.
customer "C-OVER"
	name: "Overpaying Customer"
	currency: CAD

invoice "INV-OVER"
	customer_id: "C-OVER"
	currency: CAD
	date_opened: 2026-01-01
	entry:
		date: 2026-01-01
		description: "A line"
		account: "Income:Sales"
		quantity: 1
		price: 100
		taxable: false
		tax_included: false
	posted:
		date: 2026-01-01
		due: 2026-01-31
		ar_account: "Assets:Accounts Receivable"
		memo: "Invoice INV-OVER"
		accumulate: true
	payment:
		date: 2026-01-15
		amount: 250.00
		bank_account: "Assets:Bank"
		memo: "Paid too much"
		prepayment: 150.00
